question: Tatranky nesú meno po našich veľhorách, no značka, ktorá ich tradične vyrába, je pomenovaná podľa českého mesta. Podľa ktorého?
source_excerpt: Currently it is produced in Slovakia by Sedita company in Sereď and in the Czech Republic by Opavia.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks see Tatranky as a Slovak icon because of the Tatra name, but the brand belongs to a Czech company named after a Czech city. The brand name Opavia points straight to the answer, so a player who knows it can reason their way there.
extra.verification_notes: Opavia, the Czech producer of Tatranky, is named after the city of Opava (name dates from the 1958 merger); Sedita, the Slovak producer, is not named after a Czech city.

explanation: Tatranky patria pod značku Opavia, ktorá dostala meno podľa sliezskej Opavy. Najslávnejšia „slovenská“ oblátka je teda vlastne česká.
